definitions.explanation: The place where a person was born or grew up. A very common topic in self-introductions in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {出身地|しゅっしんち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出身地|しゅっしんち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧です。
⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{出身地|しゅっしんち}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しく→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When we found out we were from the same place, we became close right away.

notes:
USAGE:
{出身地|しゅっしんち} is a standard way to refer to one's place of origin. It is commonly asked about in ⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧ (self-introductions). For informal speech, ⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧？ is more natural than the full compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出身地|しゅっしんち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to ask about someone's hometown)
- {出身地|しゅっしんち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ (to be from the same place)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧ alone also means "from" or "coming from" and is used more broadly (⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧ — university graduate).
